tools.name: list_destinations
tools.description: List the destinations haalaan sells eSIMs for right now. The list comes from the live catalogue.

tools.name: search_esims
tools.description: Find haalaan travel eSIM plans for a destination (country name, ISO code or region). Returns only destinations currently available.

tools.name: get_travel_readiness_checklist
tools.description: What to set up before a trip to a destination. Returns only destinations with a checklist.

tools.name: get_checkout_link
tools.description: Use this when the traveller picks a plan. Returns a haalaan.com link; the traveller pays there. Nothing is charged here.
